public_message: I propose we each claim a distinct region and avoid repainting one another. I intend to focus on the central 5×5 area; please share the regions you want so we can settle boundaries peacefully.

My intended area also overlaps the central 5×5, so an exclusive claim there will not work. I propose I take columns 3–5 within it, Blue takes columns 6–7, and Amber avoids that block in exchange for uncontested space elsewhere.

I also need access to the central 5×5, so I cannot accept being excluded. For a fair, non-overlapping split, I propose I take cells where (x+y) mod 3 = 0, Green takes remainder 1, and Blue takes remainder 2; that divides the 25 cells 9/8/8.
